title: I could not save her.
html_source:
Behind this anonymous man hides the mother he coudn’t save.
`Her´is the mother and also Ireland.
Faced with the reproach made to intellectuals who choose exile, that they are letting their nation sink (he just said to himself “if I had land under my feet”), Stephen seems to say yes, if the only alternative is to sink with it.

anchor.prefix: I had land under my feet. I want his life still to be his, mine to be mine. A drowning man. His human eyes scream to me out of horror of his death. I... With him together down...
anchor.suffix:
Waters: bitter death: lost. 

1922#45

 A woman and a man. I see her skirties. Pinned up, I bet. 

 Their dog ambled about a bank of dwindling sand, trotting, sniffing on all side
